entities.summary: Torstein Lofthus is a Norwegian drummer and composer associated with bands like elephant9, Red Kite, Mathias Eick Band, and the trio Eberson/Zanussi/Lofthus. He was previously a member of the band Shining. Lofthus is a popular studio musician, and is often seen behind the drums in TV shows' house bands, e.g. for "Hver gang vi møtes". Torstein Lofthus was a composers & musicians from Øystese (b. 1977-03-10, Øystese). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
